edge.trigger: Changing the password, resetting the authenticator, disabling the account, or performing Log out all devices
edge.expect: The server revokes the account's old credentials and rejects old JWTs even if their expiry has not arrived. Ordinary Log out at least revokes the current device session and clears local login state.
